bridge_changes: Defer torque enable until verified current-pose hold on all selected joints.
Keep calibration limits and session-generation cancellation.
Clear the previous companion goal-velocity cap to zero/default.
No relative target clipping; stock SO follower default max_relative_target=None.
The upstream connectivity decorator is replaced by the generation/port-open gate; copied function bodies are unchanged.
Restore volatile Torque_Limit (48) to the saved EEPROM Max_Torque_Limit (16), matching power-on behavior and clearing an interrupted 10% identification cap; gripper stays at 500.

Validated follower gripper Present_Position replies carrying only overload status 0x20 continue after upstream protection settings are verified; gripper torque-off with this alarm requires exact zero read-back. Other faults remain fatal. Semantics checked against huggingface/lerobot@baf68724e867113e6052bb3159b04dcb97e88866 motors_bus.py read/write/sync_read, which distinguish alarms from refused operations.

Human manual, handguide and leader/follower observations follow upstream normalization: sampled calibration endpoints do not terminate a session; degree measurements remain unbounded by those samples and gripper measurements clamp to 0/100. Physical encoder validity, strict startup/agent admission and bounded commanded goals are retained. Excursions are journaled.

Camera recording peeks at a recent background-captured frame (500 ms freshness), while AI timed observations still read fresh hardware. PNG writes use a bounded asynchronous queue and upstream compression level 1. Recording failures pause collection and preserve motor control under its existing heartbeat/Stop gates; episode saves drain pending images and remain retryable after metadata errors. The control cycle compensates for work time as upstream CycleTimer does.

Apply current upstream STS3215 single-turn feedback configuration by clearing only Phase bit 4 while torque is off, verify it before the first control read, and preserve every other Phase bit. Configure passive-leader timing/position mode without enabling torque. Re-lock and verify every unlocked EEPROM after configuration, including failure paths. Half-turn homing clamps the one unrepresentable +2048 offset to +2047, as current upstream does; existing calibration files are not rewritten.
